onboarding.title: Choose where your data lives
onboarding.body: Daymark keeps everything in plain Markdown files that you own: one file per day inside month folders, plus _backlog.md, _categories.md and _settings.md. Pick a folder — one inside Nutstore, OneDrive, iCloud Drive, Syncthing or a WebDAV-synced folder works well, because syncing the folder is what syncs your devices.
onboarding.hint: The folder will hold YYYY-MM/YYYY-MM-DD.md day files and three underscore files for backlog, categories and settings. Any text editor can read them.

task.title: Title
task.aiPlaceholder: e.g. Lunch with Ana next Tuesday at noon, category Work
task.aiHint: The assistant only fills this form — review the fields, then save. Nothing is created automatically.
task.aiPick: The sentence matches several tasks — pick one:
task.aiNoTasks: No task could be read from that sentence.
task.aiFailed: The assistant could not fill the form: {{message}}

reports.title: Reports
reports.assessmentHint: Assessment month starts on day {{day}}; assessment year starts in month {{month}}. Change these in Settings.

settings.title: Settings
settings.assessmentMonthHint: Day 1 is the calendar month. Day 26 means the 26th of one month through the 25th of the next.
settings.assessmentYearHint: The assessment year starts on day {{day}} of this month and runs for twelve months.
settings.conflict: Another device changed the data folder. Reload to see the changes.
settings.dataPathHint: Keep this folder inside a synced location to use Daymark on several devices.
settings.webdavHint: Uploads the same Markdown files to a WebDAV folder. This is a manual, one-way-at-a-time sync: review the result before relying on it.
settings.webdavRemotePathHint: Created if it does not exist. Default: /daymark/
settings.webdavPasswordHint: Stored in this device's local settings only — never in _settings.md or the synced folder.
settings.webdavConflicts: Conflict copies (the local originals were kept):
settings.aiHint: Optional. Sends the current report text to Anthropic and shows the answer for review before saving.
settings.aiApiKeyHint: Stored in this device's local settings only — never in _settings.md or the synced folder.
settings.aiPrivacy: Only the selected report's title, period, categories and task titles are sent. Notes, the API key and local paths are never included. Nothing is written until you press Save.
